decisions.reason: The firm has shown the track spotlight on its own page for two years running, so it is committed to it as part of its track lighting range and has sunk development costs to justify.
The ceiling luminaire has kept its own page since 2023, a sign of continued visible commitment, and any weak sales can still be put down to the slow construction market.
Launched only in 2024 with its own page, the flexible spotlight has had too little time to fail, and dropping it would contradict a decision the firm just announced.
The multi-outlet canopy is a recent launch with dedicated presentation, and it supports the firm's luminaire system, so management will keep investing in it.
The low-voltage canopy fits the firm's new system direction and was launched only last year, so management will attribute any slow uptake to temporary causes.
The glass track luminaires are only mentioned on the website, which means less visible commitment, but they belong to the track range the firm is building and are too new to judge.
